notes.title: Madzik Episode 1 is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Champions of Zikverländ, answer the call and put an end to the Nightfalls!
[/h1]

[b]Today marks the exciting release of Madzik! Madzik - Episode 1 is now available for $6.99 USD, including a 30% launch discount.[/b]

[previewyoutube=035e4l0tUdU;full][/previewyoutube]

Smash Your Path to Destiny! Embark on a narrative-driven hack and slash adventure infused with a nostalgic '80s vibe. In the ever-shifting world of Zikverländ, every creature undergoes formidable transformations, providing a thrilling and dynamic challenge through perilous moons.

[h2]Key Features:
[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Cooperative Gameplay: [/b]Team up with a friend to unlock the full potential of the moons and defeat the corrupting forces. Your success depends on how well you collaborate with each other. Join forces and rise to the challenge together!
[*][b]Narrative Journey: [/b]Madzik unfurls a captivating tale that comes to life with every encounter. With banter enriched by stunning voiceovers and engaging cutscenes between characters, this is one journey you will truly remember.
[*][b]Empowering Transformation: [/b]Channel the Madzik energy to morph into a more formidable and powerful version of yourself, unlocking new strengths and abilities.
[*][b]Dynamic Moon System: [/b]Witness the environment and enemies transform before you, their tactics and powers shifting with each lunar phase. Exploit their weaknesses and prepare for new challenges as you face off against ever-evolving adversaries.
[*][b]Handcrafted Mystical Lands:[/b] Set foot in lively and handcrafted lands, filled with rewarding exploration opportunities. From wool to pencil, Zikverländ is shaped with IRL elements that bring a unique aspect to the game.
[*][b]Versatile Ability System:[/b] Madzik's ability system is part of your adventure, offering an array of diverse and customizable skills. It's designed to offer a unique avenue for customization. Find the playstyle that suits you best.
[/list]

👉 [b]Madzik - Episode 1 is now available for $6.99 USD, including a 30% launch discount.[/b]

notes.title: Meet the heroes of Madzik: Veroline and Makino!
notes.content:
Meet the heroes of Madzik: Veroline and Makino!

Veroline may look like a mere plush doll, but she is also a powerful spellcaster who has mastered the arcane arts to unleash devastating spells on anyone who stands in her way. She uses her magical abilities to control the battlefield and escape her attackers. With her special abilities, she harnesses the elemental powers of the Moons to defeat her foes. When empowered by Madzik, she embraces her darker side and gains a whole new suite of abilities to strike fear into the hearts of her adversaries.
She came into being when she was inhabited by the spirit of a young girl that is being held captive by a mysterious wizard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795189/f653af3b835ef30bd316e2364108feee27c79849.png[/img]

As for Makino, the Winged bear, he is a powerful melee fighter that charges into packs of enemies and knocks them around with his giant enchanted warhammer. Able to withstand lots of punishment, he can also bring the pain when needed. His special abilities showcase his mastery of his hammer, which he can use as a projectile as well as for sending a wave of molten lava onto groups of foes. When he consumes Madzik energy, he reverts to his animal instincts as he leaps onto enemies to maul them with his razor-sharp claws.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795189/555d4146757c57ebcd09b2d3db4f918b02595f84.png[/img]

Originally part of a tribe of Winged Bears from the Western Peaks, he befriended Veroline  and was cast into exile. Alongside his new friend, Makino made a name for himself as he wandered Zikverländ and vanquished villains. Their heroic deeds were recorded in many tomes that were passed among the people, helping Makino and Veroline amass a legion of devoted fans, ever eager to discover where their adventures took them.

You can switch between both heroes on the fly depending on the situation and your playstyle! 
👉🏻Ready to conquer challenges you’re facing? Add Madzik to your wishlist on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2193590/Madzik/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795189/1e6c97ee6e9f5f4a00f728b003302010113d20b2.png[/img]

notes.title: HACK AND SLASH THROUGH THE 80S NOSTALGIA OF MADZIK IN 2024
notes.content:
BKOM Studios invites players to immerse themselves in the enchanting world of Madzik, an upcoming cooperative, narrative-driven hack and slash adventure with a nostalgic 80s vibe set to launch in 2024. Players will have an early opportunity to rise to the challenges of Zikverländ and harness the power of Moon Madness with an exclusive Steam Next Fest demo on February 5th.

At the heart of Zikverländ lies the influence of the Moons, celestial bodies that govern the ebb and flow of magic in the realm. As players traverse through the adventure, the Moon Madness comes into play, altering environments and presenting unique power-ups and enemies based on the lunar cycle. All of the creatures throughout Zikverländ are subject to formidable moon transformations à la Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde, including our heroes. Our heroes embrace their feral and spectral states. This duality empowers them with diverse abilities, allowing for strategic shifts in combat. 

Within Zikverländ, two unique heroes – Makino and Veroline – contribute to the cooperative hack and slash experience with their distinct abilities. As players progress, they will unravel the engaging lore of Zikverländ, forge alliances, overcome challenges, and immerse themselves in a world where every note of music and every pixel on the screen echoes the spirit of that iconic era, from the neon-soaked lands to the engaging soundtracks.

Zikverländ awaits. Will you answer its call? Experience the might of Moon Madness when Madzik launches in 2024. Madzik is now available to wishlist on Steam, and the exclusive Steam Next Fest demo will be available from February 5th through February 12th. Keep up to date by joining the official Discord server, liking Madzik on Facebook, and following BKOM Studios on X.

Madzik is made possible with the financial contribution of the Canada Media Fund.

 

[b]Key Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Cooperative Gameplay: Team up with a friend to unlock the full potential of the moons and defeat the corrupting forces. Your success depends on how well you collaborate with each other. Join forces and rise to the challenge together!
[*] Explore Handcrafted Mystical Lands: Set foot in lively and handcrafted lands filled with rewarding exploration opportunities. From wool to pencil, Zikverländ is shaped with IRL elements that bring a unique aspect to the game. Add new powers to your arsenal and uncover the secrets of Madzik’s vibrant world as you venture deeper into the unknown.
[*] Dynamic Moon System: Witness the environment and enemies transform before you, their tactics and powers shifting with each lunar phase. Exploit their weaknesses and prepare for new challenges as you face off against ever-evolving adversaries.
[*] Tailor Your Strengths: Madzik’s ability system is part of your adventure, offering an array of diverse and customizable skills. It’s designed to offer a unique avenue for customization. Find the playstyle that suits you best.
[*] Two Unique Heroes: Switch from two heroes on the fly, each with a distinct and complementary role in combat.
[olist]
[*] Makino: Makino the winged bear is a powerful melee fighter that charges into packs of enemies and knocks them around with his giant enchanted warhammer.
[*] Veroline: Veroline may look like a mere plush doll, but she is also a powerful spellcaster who has mastered the arcane arts able to unleash devastating spells on anyone who stands in her way. 
[/olist]
[/list]
